comment: Modification is only legal against a FERMEE envelope that is not yet paired
(see the spec's own description of ENV_MOD01), so the response keeps statut
FERMEE. The stub echoes back whatever numeroDossier the caller sent —
modifierENV identifies the envelope that way, unlike creerENV, which mints
one — and shows a second declaration added, since ENV_MOD01's
identifiantsDeclarationAAjouter/ASupprimer arrays are the whole point of
numeroDossier is echoed as a bare scalar via the jsonPath helper; nested
objects are deliberately NOT echoed the same way (see ppns-notifications-
pending.json's comment on Handlebars and escaped quotes) — only scalars are
sensTraversee is IMPORT and estTIRATA true: UK to France is an arrival into the EU,
and French Customs' guidance for emergency humanitarian aid to Ukraine is TIR/ATA
without a transport contract (issue #24). The declaration is an ENS accordingly.
These three stubs describe the same traffic, so they agree with each other.
